title: The Shaking Hand
logline: An artisan's apprentice secretly buys machine-drawn cuprite wire to fake their masterwork guild trial before fuel tremors ruin their hands.

roles.description: A renowned precision waveguide maker who refuses to calibrate any engine drawn by automated machinery.
A gifted metal spinner hiding advanced fuel-fume neuropathy that makes their fingers spasm under load.
Fences off-spec industrial components from deep-core salvage hulls with no questions asked.
The orbital craft guild's atmospheric foundry where masterwork engine coils are manually spun and inspected.

public_situation: Apprentices at {system}'s precision forge are preparing their hand-drawn waveguides for the annual journeyman assay.
private_truth: The master's favorite apprentice secretly used illegal machine-pulled filament after nerve damage made manual wire-drawing impossible.

beats.public_change: The guild forge fires its crucible ovens for the journeyman qualification trials.

missions.reason: The apprentice needs raw high-purity cuprite delivered to melt down so guild elders believe the wire is being pulled from raw ore.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice intends to dump the melted ore into slag and swap in pre-pulled black-market spools.

beats.public_change: The dealer demands immediate payment before releasing the counterfeit waveguide spool.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to collect the machine-turned spool from the dealer's drop locker and bring it to the forge.
missions.private_fact: The dealer intentionally notched the spool's core with an identifying serial stamp to extort the apprentice later.

beats.public_change: The master prepares the testing interferometer to certify the apprentice's finished waveguide.

missions.reason: The master suspects foreign interference in the forge power grid and asks the pilot to scan the test rig's harmonics.
missions.private_fact: The master already noticed the apprentice's trembling hands and hopes the scanner will prove the boy's innocence.

player_choice.prompt: The scan reveals the waveguide's atomic lattice is machine-perfect, proving the fraud. The master looks devastated, while the apprentice begs for silence.

options.label: Present the machine-lattice scan to uphold guild tradition
Conceal the machine scan and vouch for the apprentice's manual craft
Force the dealer to wipe the serial registry and sponsor the apprentice's clinic fees

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the machine lattice to the master.
resolutions.summary: {role:wire_master} strips {role:trembling_apprentice} of guild standing, preserving traditional craftsmanship while the ruined apprentice drifts to scrap work.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot caught an apprentice sneaking machine wire into the sacred guild crucible.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot vouches for the apprentice or certifies the wire as handcrafted.
resolutions.summary: {role:trembling_apprentice} attains journeyman rank, though {role:black_market_dealer} holds the serial record for future blackmail.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the dealer to pay the apprentice's nerve treatments.
resolutions.summary: {role:black_market_dealer} pays for nerve treatments to avoid guild exposure, while {role:trembling_apprentice} withdraws to heal.

resolutions.reached_by: The delivery fails or the pilot reports inconclusive sensor readings.
resolutions.summary: {role:wire_master} cancels the trials after crucible irregularities, leaving {role:trembling_apprentice} indentured to pay forge fuel debts.

loose_threads.detail: The counterfeit wire spool carries an automated factory calibration stamp registered to a rival commercial engine foundry.
Station infirmary logs record seven neuro-stabilizer prescriptions billed to an anonymous apprentice fund.

radio_hooks: Precision metal guild at {system} opens annual journeyman qualification trials.
Engine builders report delays as hand-drawn waveguide supplies dwindle.
Station clinics note sharp rise in chemical tremor among refinery laborers.

voice_direction.wire_master: Austere, measured, enunciating every syllable with stern pride in manual tolerances. Never raises their voice.
voice_direction.trembling_apprentice: Breathless, hurried, speaking with a slight stammer and over-apologizing for minor delays.
voice_direction.black_market_dealer: Casual, low-pitched, speaking in flat transactional terms without pretense of camaraderie.
